description: The relay's log for this application, newest first: when, how many addresses, whether it was handed to Resend or turned away, and what Resend reported afterwards (delivered, bounced, complained, delayed, failed, suppressed) with a reason. Use it to answer "did my email go out" and "why did that one not arrive". It never has a subject, a body or an address, because none is kept. `outcome` is null until Resend has reported, and always while `reporting` is false. Page with `before` set to the `next` of the last answer.

before.description: Only rows older than this time: the `next` of the previous answer.

outcome.description: Only messages Resend reported this about.

status.description: Only messages the relay handed to Resend, or only ones turned away.

name: email_activity
title: What the application's email has sent
